title: epan: Allow nested dependent frames
description:

of reassembly.

@SYN-bit I did `git bisect` for the question in !6488 and landed here.
```
                    ##########   Tue Mar 22 18:13:47 CDT 2022   ##########
wireshark$ git bisect bad
be915d7374be9d64b6fd85819fcd98b300f511af is the first bad commit
commit be915d7374be9d64b6fd85819fcd98b300f511af
```
This pcap (https://weberblog.net/the-ultimate-pcap/) with a display filter of `tcp` crashes.  
There is part of a stack dump on !6488:  
```
glib-2.0-0.dll!g_list_foreach(_GList * list, void(*)(void *, void *) func, void * user_data) Line 1091 (c:\vcpkg\buildtrees\glib\src\glib-2-b84205c786.clean\glib\glist.c:1091)
libwireshark.dll!find_and_mark_frame_depended_upon(void * data, void * user_data) Line 326 (c:\Development\wireshark\epan\frame_data_sequence.c:326)

glib-2.0-0.dll!g_list_foreach(_GList * list, void(*)(void *, void *) func, void * user_data) Line 1091 (c:\vcpkg\buildtrees\glib\src\glib-2-b84205c786.clean\glib\glist.c:1091)
libwireshark.dll!find_and_mark_frame_depended_upon(void * data, void * user_data) Line 326 (c:\Development\wireshark\epan\frame_data_sequence.c:326)

```

Thanks for digging into this @chuckcraft, I did my testing solely with tshark and did not run into me over eagerly freeing the dependent_frames glist.

I submitted a fix in !6509
